integrity: A concrete algebraic triangle/interior-point witness is provided. Exact polynomial reductions establish equality at κ and strict exclusion for every larger parameter; no global sharpness is asserted.
scientific_limitations: A matching global lower bound and a classification of all extremizing triangles/interior points are not established. The originating RGMIA date comes from its public preprint stamp; the original near-7.88 estimate could reflect unpublished algebraic work.
title: An exact algebraic upper obstruction for Liu’s pedal-inradius parameter problem
